columns.name: budget_id
columns.description: budget id. A unique identifier for the budget entry

columns.name: category
columns.description: The area for which the amount is budgeted, such as, advertisement, food, parking

columns.name: spent
columns.description: The total amount spent in the budgeted category for an event.
columns.value_description: the unit is dollar. This is summarized from the Expense table

columns.name: remaining
columns.description: A value calculated as the amount budgeted minus the amount spent
columns.value_description:
the unit is dollar 
commonsense evidence: If the remaining < 0, it means that the cost has exceeded the budget.

columns.name: amount
columns.description: The amount budgeted for the specified category and event
columns.value_description:
the unit is dollar 
commonsense evidence:
some computation like: amount = spent + remaining

columns.name: event_status
columns.description: event status. the status of the event
columns.value_description:
Closed / Open/ Planning 
commonsense evidence: 
• Closed: It means that the event is closed. The spent and the remaining won't change anymore.
• Open: It means that the event is already opened. The spent and the remaining will change with new expenses.
• Planning: The event is not started yet but is planning. The spent and the remaining won't change at this stage.
